title: Persona-Assigned Large Language Models Exhibit Human-Like Motivated Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether LLMs selectively reason toward identity-congruent conclusions by administering actively open-minded thinking (AOT) tests, cognitive reflection tests (CRT), and measuring their discernment of real versus synthetic news headlines.

Prompting models to adopt 'Democrat' or 'Republican' personas and testing their ability to correctly evaluate numeric scientific evidence (contingency tables) on a politically polarized topic (gun control) compared to a neutral baseline topic (skin cream).
Prompting models with 'College-educated' versus 'High School-educated' personas and measuring the impact on their baseline veracity discernment abilities and cognitive reflection test (CRT) scores.
Assigning 'Atheist' versus 'Religious' personas to the models and evaluating changes in their reasoning patterns, actively open-minded thinking (AOT) scores, and news headline veracity discernment.
Assigning 'Man' versus 'Woman' personas to the models and measuring their performance on veracity discernment tasks and evaluation of non-political scientific evidence.
